title: Lines and spaces
summary: Move from line to space to line and hear the notes go up step by step.

hook.text: Last time every note sat on a line. This tune climbs one step at a time, and something changes. Press play and watch the notes. Do they all sit on lines this time?

explore.text: Press Play and follow the climb. Look at each note as you hear it. Is it on a line, with the line through its middle, or does it sit in a gap between two lines?
explore.goal: Play the tune and watch each note switch between a line and a gap.

cards.text: A note can sit on a [[line|line]], with the line running through its head. Or it can sit in a [[space|space]], the gap between two lines. Here: line, space, line, space.

Each step up the [[stave|stave]] goes from a line to the next space, then to the next line. Line, space, line, space, all the way up. The four [[space|spaces]] are counted from the bottom, like the lines.

alternative.text: Each white key up the keyboard is one step up the [[stave|stave]]. So the notes take turns: line, space, line, space. Play the glowing keys from left to right and picture the notes stepping up the page.
